_about: The folk games of the village children (#30; src/core/folkgames.js; docs/FOLKGAMES.md). loCo: nhảy lò cò (hopscotch) in Phù Đổng. The court is a line of squares: up one side and back down the other (1 to 5 up, 6 to 10 down, and a half circle to rest at the top; Du lịch Việt Nam, https://www.dulichvn.org.vn/index.php/item/14698). No numeral is on the court: the children say the number of each square where the hero lands (count on; Laski & Siegler 2014). rate: the squares of a throw for each second of a hold of the action button; line: the part of a square at each edge that is a line; settle: the seconds after a landing that the hero needs to stand (a press before that is a landing on a line); long: the seconds of a press of the jump that hops two squares; short: the squares of a shorter court (after two presses too soon); hop: the seconds of a hop; rounds: the good rounds of a set; other: the seconds of the turn of another child; children: the looks of the children (data/figures.json; the first one talks, npc loco-child). levels: for each skill, the courts that the children draw (start: the first number, or starts: one of them; step: the step from a square to the next; squares; near: the called square is said as a number more than another one). rope: nhảy dây at the feast of Xóm Ruộng. period: the seconds of a turn of the rope (the rope is at the bottom at each beat); window: the seconds around a beat for a good jump; pause: the seconds that the rope stops after a miss; slower and faster: the change of the period after a miss and after a clean round; rounds: the rounds of a set; children: the looks of the two children who turn the rope (the first one talks, npc rope-child); levels: for each skill, the group of one jump and the jumps of a round (to).
